nary_nodes.label: France records 2,025 excess deaths during heatwave
evidence: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June as forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.
In France, the number of deaths recorded between 22 and 28 June increased by 2,025 - nearly 30%, the Public Health France agency announced on Friday.

nary_nodes.label: Belgium records 1,222 excess deaths during heatwave
evidence: Belgium recorded 1,222 excess deaths during the heatwave – 39% more than usual – with almost half being people aged 85 and over.

nary_nodes.label: Netherlands records 480 excess deaths during heatwave
evidence: Unprecedented heat in the Netherlands last week led to about 480 excess deaths, Dutch authorities said on Thursday - most of whom were aged 80 and older.

nary_nodes.label: European heatwave in June 2026
evidence: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June as forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.
France saw its hottest day ever on average country-wide on 24 June, with temperatures hitting almost 41C in Paris and half the nation placed under a red heat alert.

nary_nodes.label: Heatwave in Iberian Peninsula
evidence: In the Iberian Peninsula, Aemet weather service has warned of the possibility of another heatwave.

nary_nodes.label: Wildfire in Sainte-Marie-la-Mer and Canet-en-Roussillon
evidence: Nearly 3,000 people were evacuated after a wildfire ignited in the town of Sainte-Marie-la-Mer and spread to Canet-en-Roussillon on Thursday.

nary_nodes.label: Wildfires in southern France
evidence: Météo-France has issued red alerts for Friday and Saturday for forest fires in the southern part of the country, warning that weather conditions meant the risk of an outbreak was 'very high' compared to summer norms.
On Thursday, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said nearly 7,000 fires had broken out since the start of the summer season, with about 8,700 hectares burned so far.

nary_nodes.label: Heatwave in central and eastern US
evidence: As Europe braces for sweltering conditions, millions of Americans celebrating the July Fourth holiday weekend are already being affected by prolonged extreme heat and high humidity in parts of the central and eastern US.

nary_nodes.label: Climate change is driving up temperatures in Europe
evidence: Climate change is driving up temperatures around the world - but particularly in Europe. It is the fastest warming continent, heating up twice as fast as the global average, according to the Copernicus climate service.
In France, the number of deaths recorded between 22 and 28 June increased by 2,025 - nearly 30%, the Public Health France agency announced on Friday.
